title: 第11章 双修就能变强第12章 病弱狐狸
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
刚刚还懵逼的系统瞬间就像是想起了什么一般来劲了，激动的开口。
【我想起来了宿主，这可是好东西！！】
【这可是个好东西啊！！】
但是江欲显然是有些不相信这是好东西：“合欢……不是教人那什么的吗，这算什么好东西？”
系统听到这话瞬间恨铁不成钢的开口。
【宿主你能不能不要想这么歪，你的脑子里除了黄色废料还能有点其他的吗？】
“哦。”
江欲觉得不需要有。
系统彻底没招了，但还是勤勤恳恳的解释。
【宿主，现在你所在的这个世界体系里没有合欢宗这个宗门，也就是大家不知道能够通过双修来快速提升自己的实力，。】
【现在大家所说的道侣其实也只是单纯契约了能够一起出去找秘境相互照顾，所以大家其实都不是很热衷于找道侣。】
江欲这才恍然大悟的点点头：“难怪白婉婉和郑剑的关系这么好，但是两人没有结成道侣。”
【是的宿主，现在你有了这么秘籍就能用双修快速提升实力了！！】
【而且这个秘籍只有你一个人有。】
“意思就是我是唯一能够这么提升实力的。”
系统激动的点头。
【而且宿主你的这几个道侣可都是资质顶级的好的，只是现在身上都有些瑕疵，要是把他们治好了双修就可以事半功倍了！！】
这奖励可比江欲想象中的还要好：“我本来就这么喜欢修炼，老天爷还给我这么好的东西。”
“真是让我想不修炼都不行了。”
系统显然在这段时间的接触之后已经知道了江欲的真面目。

【宿主你是觉得可以正大光明的占道侣便宜才这么开心的吧。】
江欲一脚踢飞煞风景的系统，傻笑着抬起头，正好对上了沧溟疑惑的表情。
“江欲，你刚刚为什么这么着急的想要我离开，是怎么了吗？”
“没什么。”
双修的秘籍在她说话的时候已经化成了一道光进入了她的脑海里，她盯着沧溟的眼睛瞬间就亮了起来。
要是之前江欲想要占沧溟的便宜是因为他的脸和身材，现在就是各种都有了。
况且双修除了她想的那些居然还有神识交融，这江欲可熟悉了，之前看小说的时候就听里面的人描写的能够欲仙欲死。
沧溟被江欲的眼神盯得有些发毛，下意识摸了摸自己的手臂：“你干嘛这么看着我？”
江欲这才回过神开口道：“我只是想要你赶紧回来，免得再去打一巴掌白婉婉赢比赛而已。”
沧溟险些没有一口老血喷出来，这个时候这个单纯的少年才意识到江欲之前说的赌注简直就是一个无赖赌注。
“你耍无赖？？”
见自己的计谋被发现，江欲丝毫没有惊慌失措的意思，反而一脸大方的点头道：“那又怎么样？”
沧溟原本还以为自己真的有机会能够离开这个自私又恶毒的女人，现在听到这话才意识到这一切都是他想的太天真了。
content_en:
The system, which had been confused just now, suddenly seemed to be energized as if it had remembered something, and it spoke excitedly.
[I remembered the host, this is a good thing! ! 】
【This is a good thing! ! 】
But Jiang Yu obviously didn't believe that this was a good thing: "Hehuan... doesn't teach people that? What kind of good thing is this?"
When the system heard these words, it immediately spoke with hatred.
[Host, can you stop thinking so crookedly? Is there anything else besides yellow waste in your mind? 】
"Oh."
Jiang Yu felt that there was no need to have it.
The system was completely out of ideas, but I still explained diligently.
[Host, there is no Hehuan Sect in the world system you are in now, which means that everyone does not know that you can quickly improve your strength through dual cultivation. 】
[What everyone calls Taoist partners now is actually just a contract to go out to find secret places and take care of each other, so no one is actually very keen on finding Taoist partners. 】
Jiang Yu suddenly understood and nodded: "No wonder Bai Wanwan and Zheng Jian have such a good relationship, but they have not formed a Taoist couple."
[Yes, host, now that you have such a secret, you can use dual cultivation to quickly improve your strength! ! 】
[And you are the only one who has this secret book. 】
"It means that I am the only one who can improve my strength in this way."
The system nodded excitedly.
[Furthermore, these Taoist companions who are hosting you are all top-notch qualified, but they all have some flaws now. If they are cured, we can get twice the result with half the effort! ! 】
This reward is even better than Jiang Yu imagined: "I love practicing so much, God gave me such a good thing."
"It really makes me want to stop practicing."
The system obviously knew Jiang Yu's true face after this period of contact.
[Host, you are so happy because you think you can take advantage of Taoist companions openly. 】
Jiang Yu kicked the system that was destroying the scenery, raised his head with a silly smile, and met Cangming's confused expression.
"Jiang Yu, why were you so anxious to leave me just now? What happened?"
"Nothing."
The secret book of dual cultivation turned into a ray of light and entered her mind as she spoke, and her eyes lit up instantly as she stared at Cangming.
If Jiang Yu wanted to take advantage of Cangming before because of his face and figure, now he has everything.
Moreover, in addition to what she thought, the dual cultivator actually had the fusion of spiritual consciousness. Jiang Yu was familiar with this. When I read the novel before, I heard the people in it described it as being able to ecstasy.
Cang Ming was a little frightened by Jiang Yu's gaze, and subconsciously touched his arm: "Why are you looking at me like that?"
Jiang Yu finally came back to his senses and said, "I just want you to come back quickly so that you don't have to slap Bai Wanwan again to win the game."
Cangming almost spit out a mouthful of old blood. At this moment, the innocent young man realized that the bet Jiang Yu mentioned before was simply a rogue bet.
"Are you being a rogue??"
Seeing that his plot was discovered, Jiang Yu didn't mean to panic at all. Instead, he nodded generously and said, "So what?"
Cangming originally thought that he really had a chance to leave this selfish and vicious woman, but now after hearing these words, he realized that all this was too naive.
